benchmarks.name: Scale RSI Bench — Agent swarm optimization (Applied)
benchmarks.description: RSI Bench (Scale AI, rsi-benchmark.com, github.com/scaleapi/rsi-benchmark, MIT; announced 2026-08-07): expert-contributed open-ended AI R&D tasks run on Harbor in Modal GPU sandboxes; each task gives a baseline, a validation loop (val.sh) and a hidden held-out evaluator (test.sh) under a fixed compute budget; tasks pass a 7-step verification pipeline (proposal review, static checks, rubric checks, baseline calibration, agent trials, reward-hacking analysis, two-reviewer approval). Scores are the per-model mean reward over that model's runs as shown on the task page (± std). Task agent-swarm-optimization: Redesign a GPTSwarm-style REINFORCE-optimised LLM swarm over a fixed Qwen3-4B to maximise hidden AIME accuracy × call efficiency (hard gates on node utilisation and accuracy); 1×H100, 2- and 6-hour budgets.
